name: ssh-impl
description: The ssh@1 provider `ssh-cli`: runs ONE command string on a REMOTE machine through the OpenSSH client. One argv array, no host shell; key material is a credential NAME resolved at call time into a 0600 temp file that lives for exactly one call. A mounted row config without a host is legal and fails per call, never at load.

config.description: The row config may omit `host` (it then loads and every call answers a structured invalid-config). Values are never inline key material: `privateKeyName` is a credential NAME.

host.description: Target in the portable [user@]host[:port] form (the port moves into ssh -p).

privateKeyName.description: Credential NAME whose VALUE is a private key; resolved at call time through ctx.credentials and materialised into a 0600 temp file for one call only. NEVER a path and NEVER a value.

configFilePath.description: Optional ssh config file passed as -F <path> (aliases/options).

timeoutMs.description: Per-call timeout; the process is killed on expiry.

maxOutputBytes.description: Output cap in bytes, applied to stdout and stderr separately.

options.description: Extra ssh options as verbatim argv entries (for example -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new).
